Independent reconstruction verifies the global max relay construction, negative-energy grazing classification, no-Zeno argument, cross-word continuous dependence, indexed-zero continuity, automatic premise completeness with exactly 2n active events, terminal joint-zero first-order softness, oriented-zero lemma, and reflection consequence. In particular the terminal bootstrap confines any material disagreement to O(|delta q|), gives velocity error O(delta q^2) and position error O(|delta q|^3), retains both indexed zeros in the comparison window, and yields O(delta q^2) zero-time error, so the trusted R8 chamber derivative is the derivative of the global residual. The fixed-mu theorem is correctly separated from existence, equal-norm orientation in mu, the min route, and O3a. No blocking or major finding remains.

ordered_step_reconstruction: For every q>1, the cell energy E=P^2+rho U^2-(Q^2+mu^2 rho V^2)=P^2-Q^2+rho S is constant within cells and across events because the material jump is multiplied by S=0. Its initial value is 1-q^2<0.

At a nonjoint S-zero, U=epsilon mu V and tangency would force P=epsilon mu Q, hence E=(mu^2-1)Q^2>=0, contradicting strict negative energy. At a joint zero, P^2-mu^2Q^2<P^2-Q^2<0, so S has a strict negative quadratic coefficient and is negative on both punctured sides. Therefore there is neither nonzero grazing nor an ambiguous outgoing label.

Starting in material 1, successive transverse crossings determine a unique relay trajectory. A finite accumulation of relay zeros would yield S=S_t=0 by continuity and Rolle. The limit is impossible if nonjoint by the grazing contradiction and impossible if joint by its punctured negative neighborhood. Thus there is no Zeno accumulation, and the a.e.-labelled IVP exists uniquely on every compact horizon.

On compact q intervals, uniform state and derivative bounds give Arzela-Ascoli compactness. At each limiting S-zero the exact energy identity survives and reproduces the same finite zero classification. Away from that finite set the material labels stabilize; dominated convergence in the Volterra equations identifies every subsequential limit with the unique relay solution. Hence the whole state depends continuously on q without fixing a material word.

Every scalar zero is simple, and the lifted angle obeys theta_t=(y_t^2+a y^2)/(y^2+y_t^2)>=1 for a>=1. Fixed indexed zeros therefore exist on uniform finite horizons and vary continuously under uniform state convergence. Thus A_n(mu,q)=T_U^n-T_V^(n+1) is one continuous function on the connected interval q>1 across every chamber and compatible closure.

If A_n=0 at L, nodal counts make 1 and mu^2 the consecutive n-th and (n+1)-st Dirichlet eigenvalues. For W=V_tU-VU_t, strict interlacing and W_t=-(mu^2-1)rho UV give W<0 on (0,L), so V/U decreases on each U nodal cell. Its endpoint ranges cross +1/mu and -1/mu exactly once per cell; the terminal energy and parity give r/p<-1. Hence there are exactly 2n simple active relay events, negative endpoint cells, no interior joint zero, and the root lies in the exact trusted R8 scope.

For terminal softness, preserve all 2n separated internal events and continue the final negative cell smoothly. The fixed-cell switching function satisfies S^c<=-c x^2+C(|delta||x|+delta^2). Choose K with cK^2>C(K+1)+1 and then enlarge it beyond both chamber zero-time linear coefficients. Physical and chamber flows have a common state on entry to |x|<=K|delta|, all material disagreement stays inside this O(|delta|) window, both chamber indexed zeros lie inside it, and both chamber positions are O(|delta|).

On that window the vector-field mismatch is O(|delta|). The twofold Volterra estimate gives velocity error O(delta^2) and position error O(|delta|^3), stronger than the submitted O(delta^2) bound. Nonzero terminal slopes and the boundary margins preserve one physical zero of each scalar inside the window; persistence of all preceding zeros preserves the n and n+1 indices. Consequently both true-versus-chamber indexed zero-time errors are O(delta^2), so A_n=A_n^c+O(delta^2) and the trusted R8 chamber derivative is the derivative of the global residual even at event-pair birth or death.

At every zero the global residual is therefore differentiable with positive derivative. The elementary oriented-zero lemma rules out two zeros of a continuous real function on an interval. Reflection and positive reorientation produce another root q#=|r|/|p|>1 at the same mu; at-most-one gives q#=q, and global IVP uniqueness identifies the reflected trajectory with the original.
